title: Push Notifications 🔔
description: Never miss an alert again! LibraryRunCatcher now sends browser push notifications even when the tab is in the background. Just allow notifications when prompted.

title: Custom Alert Sounds
description: Choose your preferred alert tone in the Admin Dashboard: Chime, Beep, Siren, or Silent. The setting syncs to all devices in your room automatically!

title: Ultra-Fast Real-time Engine
description: Say goodbye to 2-second polling! Our new WebSocket-driven engine ensures map alerts are delivered instantly with 90% less network overhead. Experience zero-latency sync across all your devices.

title: New User Manual
description: Need help getting started? Check out the new 'How to Use' guide in the top menu. It covers everything from camera setup to multi-device sync.

title: Interactive Floor Plan Builder
description: Design a digital twin of your library with our new drag-and-drop floor plan builder. Create custom area shapes, place camera nodes with snap-to-grid precision (24px grid toggle), and monitor incidents directly on the map. Click pulsing red camera nodes to view live evidence snapshots with timestamps and zone data. Red alerts persist for 60 seconds, so no incident slips through the cracks—even when you’re away.

title: New Theme Live!
description: The new professional design system is now active. Enjoy the Deep Blue & Soft Pink premium interface.

title: PWA & Icon Refinement
description: Brand new high-resolution logo and improved PWA installation experience.
